Name: TinCanRaccoon's Female Duck for AT
Author: CallMeJax
Description:
1.1 Update: Sorry about that! There was a small typo in the manifest. It should work now.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13640]The Original Mod[/url] by TinCanRaccoon.

TinCanRaccoon's permissions state that "you are allowed to modify my files and release bug fixes or improve on the features so long as you credit me as the original creator" and "you are allowed to use the assets in this file without permission so long as you credit me."

So, full credit for all art and images goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TinCanRaccoon/about-me?gameId=1303]TinCanRaccoon[/url]. I simply converted it to an Alternative Textures Pack for use in-game if others want to have female mallards to match the vanilla duck.

Downloads.Description: Updated manifest for a typo! Also added update key.
